files.political-goals.md:
---
name: political-goals
description: John wants to enter local politics/policymaking, focusing on education and infrastructure; campaign underway; attended community meeting (by 28 Jan 2023); running for office again (Feb 2023); graduated Mar 2023; blogging on politics (Apr 2023); infrastructure community project idea (May 2023); flood in West County (Jul 2023); doubts about impact Aug 2023
type: project
---
As of 17 Dec 2022, John hopes to get into local politics. His main focuses are improving education and infrastructure in his community. Motivation: growing up he saw how poor education and crumbling infrastructure affected his neighborhood, and he believes schools and infrastructure should be properly funded. He cited a school that got funding the previous year, which paid for repairs and renovations. Next step: talk with local leaders and organizations to gather support and ideas. Maria asked him to keep her posted on his campaign.
Update 22 Dec 2022: campaign is underway; John has been networking with people to get their input. A recent conversation with someone who shared stories fired up his passion for improving local education. Maria is supportive.
Update 9 Jan 2023: John has been talking to community leaders and learning the neighborhood's needs and hopes; feels optimistic. He had a community meeting planned for around 16 Jan 2023 on education and infrastructure upgrades. Maria is taking notes on local politics to help.
Update 28 Jan 2023: John attended the community meeting. Hearing residents' worries made him realize the upgrades are crucial, especially for kids. He is upset about the state of education and wants to fight for more money and resources for schools. He notes his own kids have plenty while others lack basics.
Update 5 Feb 2023: John said he's running for office because of a strong urge to serve his country and community and make an impact.
Update 25 Feb 2023: John told Maria he is running for office again (after a previous run); he's more excited than ever. The earlier run showed him the impact he can make in the community through politics.
Update 2 Apr 2023: John graduated with his degree about the last week of Mar 2023. He is now considering a career in policymaking, particularly improving education and infrastructure. Community meetings and involvement gave him a better understanding of the challenges and their impact on neighbors.
Update 18 Apr 2023: John has been blogging about politics and government, researching policies (education reform, infrastructure development) and sharing ideas to raise awareness and spark conversation. He has had good feedback on posts. He also attended a tech-for-good convention with colleagues in March 2023 and found it energizing. He is planning a trip to the East Coast.
Update 6 May 2023: John says he decided about the last week of Apr 2023 to run for office again despite not having succeeded before. He sometimes feels overwhelmed. A power cut in his area (about late Apr 2023) made him focus on upgrading infrastructure; roads full of potholes are a main concern, plus better housing and living conditions. He is thinking of starting a community infrastructure project to get neighborhood backing, and wants to improve his old area, West County. Maria offered to help.
Update 5 Jul 2023: John feels it's an uphill battle and sometimes doubts he's making a difference, but Maria's support and his family keep him going. He sees weekly ocean sunset walks as a way to decompress.
Update 7 Jul 2023: A nasty flood hit John's old area about the last week of Jun 2023; poor infrastructure meant many homes were ruined. It reinforced his push to fix up the community. He is gathering people for a meeting to discuss solutions; Maria agreed to join and contribute.
Update 11 Aug 2023: John feels he isn't making enough impact and is questioning his goals; he plans to list and contact local organizations/volunteering programs matching his beliefs to channel his passion.

As of 6 Mar 2023: John has a wife and kids, including a one-year-old son named Kyle. They go to the park a few times a week, have picnics, and John likes finding activities (e.g. a violin concert in late Feb/early Mar 2023). He describes parenting as a wild ride with love and happiness outweighing the ups and downs.
As of 10 Apr 2023: John described a road trip last year exploring the Pacific Northwest coast and national parks; he found the nature breathtaking.
As of 5 Jul 2023: John has a daughter named Sara; a family trip last year (2022) was for her birthday. He looks at family photos for motivation when his political work gets hard.
As of 13 Aug 2023: family enjoys hikes, park, picnics, board games and movie nights. John plans to look into local shelters to adopt a dog.

files.maria-friend.md:
---
name: maria-friend
description: Maria, John's supportive friend he chats with about his campaign and family
type: user
---
Maria is a friend John chats with regularly and who encourages his political campaign. She volunteers at a homeless shelter and donated her old car there on 21 Dec 2022. She has a small family, enjoys movies, hiking and game nights with friends, and recently made peach cobbler. As of 9 Jan 2023 she made friends with a fellow volunteer and is taking notes about local politics to help John. John calls them a great team. As of 28 Jan 2023 she volunteered at a shelter event for kids (week of 21 Jan); she was inspired to volunteer by her aunt, who helped her family when they struggled. She shares John's views on funding education.
As of 5 Feb 2023: Maria did a charity event on Friday 3 Feb 2023 serving meals; she met a man named David and connected him with a housing organization. She offered to help John with networking and his food drive events.
As of 25 Feb 2023: Maria took a creative writing class recently and found it enlightening. She keeps volunteering at the shelter; on 24 Feb 2023 she met Jean, a woman who went through divorce, job loss and homelessness yet stayed optimistic.
As of 6 Mar 2023: Maria's grandma passed away about the last week of Feb 2023 and she is grieving. She has siblings, traveled to London, England a few years ago (loved the castles/architecture), and paints, making a painting inspired by it. She builds connections at the shelter by listening and showing compassion.
As of 2 Apr 2023: Maria is taking a poetry class to put her feelings into words (a rough time, but good). She and John volunteered together in 2022 and plan to keep supporting each other.
As of 7 Apr 2023: Maria ran in a 5K charity run for a homeless shelter around 1-2 Apr 2023 and found it rewarding.
As of 10 Apr 2023: Maria gave a few talks at the shelter (received compliments from volunteers), bought a cross necklace to feel closer to her faith, and helped organize a meal for shelter residents the prior week. She says shelter people feel like family.
As of 4 May 2023: Maria made dinner with her mom; she loves banana split sundaes after volunteering. She took a solo trip to Spain last year (2022) that was transformative; she tried surfing for the first time. Her balance routine: exercise, music, time with loved ones.
As of 6 May 2023: Maria joined a nearby church on 5 May 2023 to feel closer to community and faith. Life has been a bit rough but she is reflecting and seeking balance. She offered to help John with his infrastructure community project.
As of 20 May 2023: Maria is planning a ring-toss tournament for the homeless shelter's fundraiser later in May 2023. She offered to help John with his veterans project.
As of 25 May 2023: the shelter fundraiser is the following week (about 1 Jun 2023) and features a chili cook-off (she shared the poster); she hopes to cover basic needs for the homeless. John offered to spread the word and recruit volunteers.
As of 3 Jun 2023: Maria just started volunteering at a local dog shelter once a month.
As of 12 Jun 2023: Maria went camping with church friends the weekend of 3-4 Jun 2023. She went on a family road trip to Oregon when younger (waterfall/bridge hike). She has camped a few times, never mountain climbed. She does aerial yoga and loves upside-down poses; finds peace with alone time and music.
As of 16 Jun 2023: Maria joined a gym about 9 Jun 2023, loves the welcoming atmosphere, wants to get stronger and build endurance, and is trying kundalini yoga. She has not tried rock climbing. She has a Florida family beach vacation memory.
As of 27 Jun 2023: Maria said she has been struggling lately but leans on family and friends, who are her rock. Shelter volunteering helps her; a memorable moment was a sad resident laughing while she played with the kids. She plans to keep volunteering. John mentioned his family went to a live music event around 20 Jun 2023.
As of 3 Jul 2023: Maria was in a car hit by a red-light runner on 2 Jul 2023 (everyone okay). She is helping her cousin, who had to leave her home in a hurry, find a new place and asked John for housing resources/organizations; John promised to look. A shelter resident, Laura, wrote the volunteers a thank-you letter.
As of 17 Jul 2023: Maria had a picnic with church friends about 15 Jul 2023 (charades, scavenger hunt). John plans to try similar games with his kids, inspired by arts and crafts/games at a community event in Jun 2023.
As of 22 Jul 2023: Maria hiked to a summit with church friends the weekend of 15-16 Jul 2023 and found it peaceful. She plans to explore more and volunteer at shelters in Aug 2023, and was about to bake cakes.
As of 31 Jul 2023: Maria dropped off baked goods at the homeless shelter the week of 24 Jul 2023 and is more motivated than ever to help people.
As of 3 Aug 2023: Maria started volunteering at the shelter about a year ago (~Aug 2022) after seeing a family struggling on the streets; she asked the shelter if they needed volunteers. A resident, Cindy, wrote the volunteers a gratitude note.
As of 9 Aug 2023: Maria received a medal from the homeless shelter for her volunteering (week of 31 Jul-4 Aug 2023); she found it humbling.
As of 11 Aug 2023: Maria got a puppy named Coco about 28 Jul 2023; it brings her joy, though caring for her is an adjustment.
As of 13 Aug 2023: Maria adopted a second shelter pup, Shadow, about the week of 6 Aug 2023; she's energetic, learning commands and house training, and gets along with Coco. Maria had no pets growing up.

As of 20 May 2023, John is busy with a project to support military veterans and is trying to get a petition going. It is rewarding but stressful. He is passionate about veterans' rights; about the week of 13 May 2023 he decided to show appreciation for what they have done. On Friday 19 May 2023 he threw a small party where veterans shared stories and made connections. Maria offered to help with the project.

Update 3 Jul 2023: John recently took part in a march for veterans' rights; it motivated him and reinforced his belief in activism and his respect for the military.
Update 17 Jul 2023: John visited a veterans' hospital about the week of 10 Jul 2023 and met an elderly veteran named Samuel, whose stories were inspiring and heartbreaking; the veterans' resilience gave him hope and reminded him why he wanted to join the military. He describes the organization he works with as like a family.
Update 3 Aug 2023: John asked family and friends to join the virtual support group he is part of and be advocates for the military; many people joined. Update 9 Aug 2023: John organized a neighborhood 5K charity run (about 5-6 Aug 2023) to raise funds for veterans and their families. It took work: getting sponsors (the hardest part, reaching out to businesses), coordinating with the city, and publicity. Turnout was great. He has also worked with a local organization helping domestic abuse victims, raising awareness and funds at an event.
